hero.tagline: Sourcing local just got smarter. The ultimate AI-powered ecosystem for Canadian Manufacturing Enterprises.

node1.title: 1. Instant Onboarding
node1.body: Buyers and storefront accounts set up in seconds. Suppliers can auto-generate a full profile using our 2-minute AI website importer.

node2.title: 2. Request or List
node2.body: Buyers post targeted RFQs to the network. Suppliers and storefront accounts list surplus materials, equipment, or available capacity.

node3.title: 3. Match & Collaborate
node3.body: Access direct contact details to make connections. Negotiate your own terms and build long-lasting business-to-business relationships.

industries.precisionMachiningDescription: CNC milling, turning, and EDM. High tolerance capabilities for aerospace & medical.
industries.foundriesCastingDescription: Sand casting, die casting, and investment casting. Iron, steel, and aluminum alloys.
industries.surfaceFinishingDescription: Anodizing, powder coating, plating, and heat treatment services.
industries.toolingMoldsDescription: Injection molds, dies, and custom tooling solutions for mass production.
industries.automationDescription: Robotics, PLC programming, and automated manufacturing systems for increased efficiency.

marcanStandard.aiSetupBody: No tedious forms. Create a comprehensive supplier profile with your already existing website in just 2 minutes. Our AI scraper does the heavy lifting.
marcanStandard.localFirstBody: Proudly connecting you with partners found right here in Canada to strengthen our domestic supply chain.
marcanStandard.directContactBody: No middlemen fees. Connect directly with manufacturers for quotes and lead times.
marcanStandard.freeBody: No hidden fees, subscriptions, or paywalls. Access the network, source materials, and grow your business completely free.

companyTypeHelp.title: How to choose your company type
companyTypeHelp.contractManufacturer: Contract Manufacturer — You manufacture parts or products for other companies based on their designs.
companyTypeHelp.distributor: Distributor — You resell parts, materials, or components made by other manufacturers.
companyTypeHelp.jobShop: Job Shop — You focus on custom, small-batch, or one-off manufacturing work.
companyTypeHelp.oem: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) — You design and manufacture your own products.
